reviews.x: I have a strong sense of smell and had trouble finding a product for my better half that had a smell I could tolerate, and kept his hair in place.  Not only can I tolerate the smell, but I actually like it. On top of that, it does great with the hair.

reviews.t: Meh. It's alright. You get what you pay for.
reviews.x: Meh. It's OK. Way better than the cheap stuff you can get at Target/Walmart. But its a far, far cry from Aveda styling clay. Not even in the same conversation, really. If you mixed the Aveda clay 50/50 with water, that is the consistency that this has. But you'd still be better off with 50/50 water/Aveda clay mix. Granted, this costs less than half. My point is it is okay for the price, but don't think you have found a cheap version of something better. You get what you pay for.  It doesn't hold

reviews.t: Not as much of a warrior as it could be
reviews.x: I really wanted to like this styling clay as there are a lot of good reviews. Going to start with the negatives first and then end on a positive note.  What I didn't like: The hold wasn't very strong and it didn't last all day. Also most products help with shaping the hair, but this product (maybe also related to the strength of the hold) did not help as much with the initial styling.  What I did like about the product: This product is made with real clay - bentonite is one of the ingredients! T

reviews.t: I have ordered this styling "paste" twice and I like it. It does the job for my hair
reviews.x: I have ordered this styling "paste" twice and I like it. It does the job for my hair. I do think they make a mistake calling it a clay though because it is a long-way from being clay-like. In fact, I was a long time between purchases because of this labeling issue. It's a little creamier than most products that go by clay, but it does a nice job of making the hair manageable in numerous ways. A good product wrongly named.

reviews.t: Smells great but that's about it.
reviews.x: I have thick and frizzy hair. Friend recommended I try using clay and gave me some of his to try. His brand was great but couldn't find where to buy it. After checking reviews I settled on this one.  It smells really good - kind of natural, kind of citrus. It doesn't have that obnoxiously strong "axe" smell.  But it doesn't keep my hair in check. I feel I would have to put a big gallop on for it to work. If that was the case I would have to order a new bottle weekly. It is also super sti

reviews.t: I really like this product a lot
reviews.x: I really like this product a lot! Here in Florida, it's hot, and when it's hot, I sweat... A LOT. It provides enough hold to my hair and doesn't have any leftover waxy residue on your hands that takes foreverrrrr to wash off. On that note, showering the product comes off very easy in the shower even without shampoo. Great hold, easy to style, smells great. Ladies, here I am, come run your fingers through this incredibly styled hair.

For something that is advertised as styling clay, this is thin and watery — much more like a gel than any clay I’ve purchased before.  Good enough, I suppose, but I prefer a true clay for my hair, and won’t be purchasing this product again.
My son has tried a number of products over the years, he has unruly hair and when I bought thus product for him he absolutely loved it. This is the second I have ordered.
Well...It's NOT a clay. It's a hair cream. And as is, it holds very, VERY lightly. In order for you to get your hair in place, you have to smear half a can on your head.
It has a normal to medium hold. And it doesn't make my hair look shiny and greasy..The smell of this styling clay is also neither overpowering nor fruity.
Great Product! I have curly hair and its difficult to find a good product that will last all day. It looks great and lasts all day. Highly recommend!!

reviews.t: Best hair product I've tried thus far
reviews.x: Best hair product I've tried thus far. Not a matte look, but holds hair in place. Use in combination with blow dryer to get preferred wave.

reviews.t: Medium hold, lasts a long time!
reviews.x: This provides a medium hold, no white residue and washes away easily with running water. Price is right and a little goes a long way!

reviews.t: Par product with little to write home about
reviews.x: I was hoping for more of a clay texture.  It was more greasy and didn't hold very well at all. In addition, it didn't smell good.
Medium hold and not greasy.  Your hair feels natural and not coated with the product.
No real distinct smell. Does great on my hair. No problems with it at all.
I've used other clay products but this item is more like a liquid paste

reviews.t: Best hair styling product I've ever used!
reviews.x: Love this stuff... much better than any other hair product I've tried.

reviews.t: Great for guys with short, thick hair
reviews.x: This hair cream will hold nicely and is easy to apply and rinse out

I think it's funny how they say "We give you more" when the item is 2oz and every other product like it is 3.5oz and over. But that's besides the point. I feel the product worked then I would be more than happy with a smaller amount and the price point. I am in the process of growing my hair out and have long curly hair, probably 8 inches. I was looking for a product that has a decent amount of hold and control that keeps my hair from going shiny and helps keep my head from getting frizz

reviews.t: Easy to use, does what I need it to.
reviews.x: I was looking for a replacement for Redken Firm Grasp which is either discontinued or made of platinum flakes now as I couldn't find it for less than $40 for a small container. The reviews on this sounded like just what I was looking for and I wasn't disappointed. I have short fine hair and I like a medium non-sticky hold that I can re-style if needed and that can support a messy/spiky kind of look. This product is very soft and creamy so it's easy to apply, and it dries to just the kind of hold

I really like this product, it holds well and smells pretty good plus offers a sleek look. I wouldn't quite say that it is matte because it has little shine to it but it definitely doesn't look greasy. The hold is decent too, its not the strongest holding creme but does the job as long as there's not strong wind and can easily be formed back into place with a run through of your fingers.  Overall: good product, worth the money!

Clearly some people don't understand what "Clay" is, if you think of the clay you played with as a child this is what I expect a hair clay to be like, thick and somewhat solid. This K+S product is not solid as I was expecting. it is very much a liquid I can almost pour out of the container and was exactly what I didn't want. I thought I had read enough reviews but apparently I missed finding info that it was a liquid.

This stuff worked well for me.  No clumps or white paste in the hair.  You look at it and wonder how it disappears when you rub it in your hair... but it does.  Holds really well.  I would totally buy this again.  The only reason I wouldn't give it 5 stars is that I really am not sure how it compares to other clays.  Clay is harder for me to use than gels... but yes - this stuff is good.

reviews.t: Works great with a matte finish
reviews.x: Works great with a matte finish. And it smells really good. You only need a small gob and you're pretty good to go.  5/10/17 Just wanted add a follow up, to the product. I just bought my second jar because it's done so well. It's the product that helps provide the most volume throughout the day. I will continue using only the Styling Clay as my hair product of choice.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the product's hold and effectiveness for styling their hair.
Several reviewers note the product is not a true clay, describing it as thin, watery, creamy, or gel-like rather than clay-textured.
Some reviewers find the hold weak or short-lasting, saying it doesn't keep hair in place all day.
Reviewers frequently comment positively on the scent, describing it as pleasant and not overpowering.
Multiple reviewers mention the product washes out easily and leaves no greasy or waxy residue.
